-P PREROUTING ACCEPT
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-P POSTROUTING ACCEPT
-A PREROUTING -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m comment --comment "kaskad:443:tcp" -j DNAT --to-destination 198.51.100.20:443
-A PREROUTING -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -m comment --comment "kaskad:8443:tcp" -j DNAT --to-destination 198.51.100.20:443
-A PREROUTING -p udp -m udp --dport 51820 -m comment --comment "kaskad:51820:udp" -j DNAT --to-destination 198.51.100.30:51820
-A POSTROUTING -o enp0s3 -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -o enp0s3 -m comment --comment "kaskad:masq" -j MASQUERADE
